errors.evidence: The y-axis unit is clearly labeled as "in Mrd. Euro" (in billions of Euros), not "in Millionen Euro" (in millions of Euros). This error is repeated throughout the description and makes all numerical values incorrect by a factor of 1000.
The color used to represent the "Innere Sicherheit" category in the legend and bars is purple, not red ("rot").

errors.evidence: The values provided for the year 2015 are incorrect. The total is closer to 36 billion Euro. The components are approximately: "äußere Sicherheit" is ~31 billion (not 28), "innere Sicherheit" is ~4 billion (not 6), and "Abwehr hybrider Gefahren" is ~1 billion. errors.text_span: Die Ausgaben für äußere Sicherheit und innere Sicherheit steigen kontinuierlich an
errors.evidence: This statement is factually incorrect. The spending on "äußere Sicherheit" (blue segment) decreases after 2022. The spending on "innere Sicherheit" (purple segment) also appears to stagnate or slightly decrease after 2021. Therefore, the trend is not a continuous increase for either category.
